_instructions: Define 3-5 ICPs. Save as icp_profiles.json in your client's config/ folder. Each ICP needs all fields filled in; they're injected into agent prompts at runtime.

icps.name: Human-readable ICP name (e.g. 'The Power User')
icps.persona: Age range, role, life stage, demographic context
icps.awareness_stage: One of: Unaware / Problem-aware / Solution-aware / Product-aware / Most-aware
icps.search_behavior: What kind of queries this ICP types into ChatGPT/Perplexity. Specific search habits, vocabulary, info-source preferences.
decision_criteria: Top 3-4 things this ICP evaluates when choosing a solution
objections: Top 2-3 reasons this ICP might pass on the brand
preferred_sources: The kind of sources this ICP trusts most (e.g. peer-reviewed, expert YouTubers, government, peer communities)
icps.tone: tone descriptor — 1-3 adjectives for how content should sound to this ICP
ctas: 1-2 actions appropriate for this ICP's awareness stage
